name: ws
description: ws — whetstone: sharpen the thinking before the work, and the work before it lands. Four skills. /ws:grill (user-only) runs a relentless, round-based interview over the design tree of a plan, decision or idea, asking the whole settled frontier at a time with a recommendation attached to every question; silence never settles a question. /ws:test-gate (model-invoked) gates every test as it is written — four questions, a shared junk-pattern check, red-before-green for regressions — extends existing tests rather than restructuring them, and notes the concerns it finds instead of fixing them. /ws:test-audit (user-only) audits and consolidates an existing suite, evidence first and one approved batch at a time, with a campaign mode for a whole subsystem. /ws:deslop (user-only) is a behaviour-preserving cleanup pass that strips AI slop from a diff before /code-review. No hooks, no MCP.
